description: Explosive Trap Level 60 275 Mana Instant 30 sec cooldown Requires Hunter Requires level 34 Place a Fire trap that explodes when an enemy approaches, causing 105 to 135 Fire damage and 150 additional Fire damage over 20 sec to all within 10 yards. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Fire trap can be active at a time.
name: Explosive Trap
